text:
Jules (People Ops): Dropping answers from the all-hands Q&A thread — thanks for the great questions. I'll summarize and add follow-ups here.

Kori: Thanks! First one: are comp bands changing in the new guide? I heard mention of a "midpoint shift" on slide 4.

Jules (People Ops): Short answer: bands and titles are the same. We updated midpoint guidance to reflect market data for a handful of benchmarking roles (infra, senior infra eng, and PM). This affects offer and market adjustments, not title criteria.

Diego (Eng): For folks who just had a pay bump last month, are they eligible for a market adjustment this cycle?

Samira (People Ops): They can be considered, yes, but priority is given to people below market midpoint and at retention risk. If you got a recent bump due to hire correction, mention it in the packet and we'll flag it.

Nina: Parental leave question: will Redwood provide top-up beyond statutory leave? The slide said "parental support" but no details.

Jules (People Ops): We are rolling a pilot for parental top-ups for the next 6 months for primary caregivers: up to 8 weeks of partial pay top-up (50% of base) on top of statutory leave, subject to eligibility. HR will post the pilot FAQ and the eligibility checklist tomorrow.

Omar (Manager): Nice. Related: does time off during the review window hurt someone's promo chances? Someone on my team took 12 weeks parental leave.

Samira (People Ops): Time off does not automatically penalize. Managers should document sustained impact and signal continuity of work. If an IC was on leave, include a short note in the packet and evidence of work before/after leave. We have accommodations for timing (late packet submission allowed).

Diego (Eng): Appeals process - how formal is it? Who reviews an appeal?

Jules (People Ops): Appeals are handled by People Ops + a cross-functional panel (People Ops, a senior manager outside the candidate's org, and a senior IC reviewer). Timeline: appeals window opens on notice day and runs for 14 calendar days. We triage for scope and may ask for more evidence.

Kori: Retroactive pay? If someone was underpaid last fiscal year and we discovered it now, does that count toward comp adjustments this cycle or is it on a separate retro payroll?

Eva (Finance): Retro corrections are processed separately through payroll and show as a retro adjustment; they do not consume the market adjustment budget. If the correction is tied to role misclassification, both retro and a market adjustment can apply — we'll coordinate with People Ops.

Nina: Will there be public guidance/examples on what a "strong" packet looks like? Engineers on my team keep asking for examples.

Jules (People Ops): Yes — we will publish 4 short anonymized packet examples (IC and Manager narrative + evidence bullets) and a checklist for managers by Monday. Use them in calibration prep.

Omar (Manager): Any extra context for international employees re: local labor law and notice timing? Some of our EMEA folks asked.

Samira (People Ops): Local labor laws can change timelines for notices and appeals. We will share country-specific notes in the FAQ (EMEA APAC NA). If you're unsure, cc people-ops@redwood.com and international-hr@redwood.com.

people-ops-bot: Docs linked: https://redwood.internal/hr/reviews-guide and https://redwood.internal/hr/parental-topup-pilot (FAQ live tomorrow).

Diego (Eng): One last one: any change to leveling criteria for technical IC tracks vs. manager track? We get edge cases where people do both.

Jules (People Ops): No changes to core leveling criteria. We clarified crossover guidance: if someone is doing significant IC+management work, managers should pick the primary track and call out the hybrid responsibilities in the packet; calibration will consider scope and impact across both.

Kori: Thanks — what if managers disagree with People Ops during calibration?

Jules (People Ops): Calibration is a conversation. If there's disagreement, People Ops will document the rationale and next steps; unresolved cases go to the senior calibration panel. People Ops will notify managers if any additional context is required.

Nina: Appreciate this thread. Will the parental pilot details include how to apply and the required paperwork?

Samira (People Ops): Yes, step-by-step and the HR form link will be in the FAQ. We'll run a short AMA session next week for managers.

Diego (Eng): :thumbsup:

Jules (People Ops): I'll upload the packet examples and the FAQ here once they're live. If you need a private follow-up, DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com.
